digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate fingerprinting and attestation validation
propositions: Whitespace-only edits to no_file_impact_reason produce different material fingerprints and invalidate signed reviews as stale-material, violating the original whitespace-normalization invariant
material_basis() canonicalizes descriptions but inserts no_file_impact_reason as raw bytes, bypassing the normalize_insignificant_whitespace() contract

The fix adds an independent normalize_reason parameter (default True) flowing through material_basis, material_fingerprint, and current_material_fingerprint_impl to normalize boundary/trailing whitespace in reasons

_legacy_material_ok() must explicitly disable reason normalization in pre-330c, post-330c/pre-2be7, and post-2be7/pre-fix candidate generations to preserve byte-exact historical fingerprint reproduction

Boundary and trailing whitespace variants of no_file_impact_reason now produce identical current fingerprints and certified status, while substantive edits (interior whitespace, word changes) remain material and produce stale-material
Existing plan-review, legacy, and lint gates all pass with the fix, confirming no regression or secondary broken assumption
